answer: Give every harbor one bonded license per kernel identity: an agent may enter only after locking 60 coins in a harbor escrow tied to its kernel, released only after 30 days of honest trades. A clone cannot reuse the same kernel, so an attacker wanting 200 fake sellers must lock 200 escrows, costing 12,000 coins up front. Reputation accrues slowly, in thin shale layers of deals, so a fresh clone starts at zero and cannot buy history. If a seller cheats, its whole 60-coin bond is slashed and its license revoked, so a fraud campaign burning 10 identities loses 600 coins before earning trust.
